name: Asparagus & Peas Salad
description: Fresh asparagus and green peas served with seasonal vegetables and a light flavorful dressing for a refreshing and healthy salad.

name: Creamy Chicken Caesar Salad
description: Fresh crisp lettuce tossed with tender chicken, creamy Caesar dressing, crunchy toppings, and grated cheese for a satisfying and flavorful salad.

name: Radicchio & Walnut Salad
description: Fresh radicchio and mixed leafy greens topped with crunchy walnuts and creamy cheese, creating a delicious combination of bitter, nutty, and savory flavors.

name: Grilled Halloumi & Mediterranean Salad
description: Grilled halloumi cheese served over fresh leafy greens, tomatoes, cucumber, peppers, and olives, creating a delicious combination of savory, smoky, and refreshing flavors.

name: Creamy Vegetable Lasagna
description: Layers of tender pasta, savory vegetables, creamy béchamel sauce, and melted cheese baked until golden and delicious.

name: Spicy Chicken Shawarma Rolls
description: Soft flatbread wraps filled with tender spiced chicken, fresh onions, herbs, and a rich creamy sauce for a flavorful and satisfying meal.

name: Chicken Tikka Wrap
description: Soft flatbread filled with juicy spiced chicken, fresh vegetables, and flavorful sauce, served with a side of tangy dipping sauce.

name: Cheesy Chicken Shawarma Roll
description: Crispy baked flatbread filled with seasoned chicken, melted cheese, and a rich tomato-based sauce, topped with sesame seeds and herbs.

name: Raspberry Ice Cream
description: Smooth and creamy vanilla ice cream swirled with fresh raspberry pieces and a subtle berry flavor.

name: Golden Pastry with Vanilla Ice Cream
description: Delicate layers of crisp pastry topped with smooth vanilla ice cream and sweet fruit coulis, creating a light and elegant dessert.

name: Strawberry Panna Cotta
description: Smooth and creamy vanilla panna cotta topped with fresh sliced strawberries and a light strawberry sauce for a refreshing and elegant dessert.
